note: Oklahoma State lists a hydroponic pH range of 6.0–7.0 for lettuce. Treat this as a source-specific starting range and compare it with the needs of the chosen variety and system.
Oklahoma State lists a hydroponic pH range of 5.5–6.0 for basil. Measure the nutrient solution regularly rather than assuming that the initial pH stays unchanged.

Lettuce has shallow roots. Minnesota Extension gives about one inch of weekly rainfall as adequate and recommends more frequent watering in sandy soil. Check soil moisture; this outdoor guideline is not a fixed dose for an indoor pot.
Prune basil periodically during the growing season to keep growth productive and tender. When harvesting whole stems, cut just above a pair of leaves so new growth can develop there.
